requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via a map-based interface or Telegram bot. The system manages a lifecycle from submission and approval by public relations officers to assignment, execution (by internal staff or external maintainers), and resolution. It features role-based access for citizens, municipal staff, administrators, and external partners, with robust notification systems (email, push, platform messages) and statistical dashboards.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to download the summary table of reports 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: If a filter is active on the table view, only filtered data should be downloaded
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be tied to a specific geographic location (latitude/longitude).

Report categories are fixed: Water Supply, Architectural Barriers, Sewer System, Public Lighting, Waste, Road Signs and Traffic Lights, Roads and Urban Furnishings, Public Green Areas and Playgrounds, Other.
Report statuses are: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
Rejected reports must include a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Internal comments between technical office staff and external maintainers are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Communication between technical office and external maintainers without access to Participium is out of scope.
Only authenticated users (citizens) can view reports initially; from Sprint 4, unregistered users can also view reports.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map for citizens.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Municipal public relations officer and municipal administrator roles are automatically associated with the Organization Office.
Email is mandatory for registration and can be used for login.
Confirmation code for registration is valid for 30 minutes.
Photo attachment limit is 1 to 3 per report.
edge_cases: External maintainer resolves a report (Case 1: has access) vs. Technical office resolves it (Case 2: no access).
Zooming out on the map groups reports into a cumulative view showing total count.
Downloading CSV with active filters only exports the filtered subset.
Following a report that is already 'Resolved' or 'Rejected' is not allowed.
Sending an email notification when the user has disabled it in their configuration panel.
Assigning multiple roles to a user where only 'technical office staff member' allows multiple assignments.
Automatic assignment bypasses the initial review step for specific categories.
Telegram bot commands like '/subscribe report 12345' target a specific report ID.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' is a logical grouping within the Municipality of Turin responsible for initial intake and oversight.
Competent technical offices are pre-configured in the system with their respective categories.
External maintainers are added to the system by the system administrator (as per FAQ notes).
Telegram push notifications require an active internet connection on the user's device.
The 'top 1% of reporters' statistic is calculated based on the total number of reports submitted by each unique reporter ID.
Unregistered users viewing reports cannot submit new reports or interact with the messaging system.

authentication_notes: /auth/session (POST) establishes the session required for all subsequent authenticated operations.
/auth/session (GET) confirms active session state before accessing protected resources.
/auth/session (DELETE) cleans up session state to prevent unauthorized access after logout.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: Resource creation: /reports (POST) is prerequisite for all report-specific operations (/reports/{id} GET/POST, comments, assignments).
User management: /users (POST) creates users required for /users/{id} operations and role-based access.
POST /email/send-verification -> POST /auth/verify: Verification code must be sent before it can be verified.
POST /reports -> GET /reports/{id}: Report ID must exist before retrieving specific report details.
POST /reports -> POST /reports/{id}: Report ID must exist before updating status or category.
POST /reports -> POST /reports/{id}/comments: Report ID must exist before adding internal comments.
POST /reports -> GET /reports/{id}/comments: Report ID must exist before listing internal comments.
POST /reports -> GET /reports/{id}/comments/unread: Report ID must exist before listing unread comments.
POST /users/municipality-users -> GET /reports/municipality-users/{municipalityUserId}: Municipality user must exist before listing their reports.
POST /users/external-users -> POST /reports/{report_id}/external-maintainers: External maintainer account must exist before assigning report to them.
POST /users/external-users -> GET /reports/external-maintainers/{id}: External maintainer ID must exist before listing their assigned reports.

risks: Ambiguity in role requirements for /reports/{id} (POST) and /reports/municipality-users (GET) - documentation mentions roles but does not specify exact mapping to auth tokens.
Potential race condition between /email/send-verification and /auth/verify if verification code expires before use.
Rate limiting on /auth/resend-code (3 per hour) may impact user experience during high-volume registration periods.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/reports-map without providing any authentication headers or session tokens. Verify that the response contains a list of approved reports (status: Resolved) visible on the map, including their geographic coordinates and basic details.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality for unregistered users as per requirement PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Ensure an external maintainer user has an active session. Perform a POST request to /reports/{id} with a payload setting the status to 'Resolved' or 'In Progress'. Verify the update is accepted and the report details reflect the new status.
setup_needed: Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability of an external maintainer to update their assigned report.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a 'citizen' user. Perform a GET request to /reports/reports-map. Verify that the response includes approved reports and that the citizen's identity is handled according to domain rules (e.g., anonymous name visible to staff but hidden in public map if applicable, though this endpoint is public).
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the map view functionality for authenticated citizens, ensuring visibility of approved reports.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Perform a POST request to /reports/{report_id}/external-maintainers with an invalid or non-existent external maintainer ID. Verify that the API returns an appropriate error code (e.g., 404 Not Found) indicating the external maintainer does not exist.
setup_needed: Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the system's handling of invalid external maintainer IDs during assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path registration for a citizen. Provide a unique username, valid email, and full name. Ensure the response indicates successful creation or returns the expected status code for duplicate usernames if applicable.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core entry point for new users as per PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user via the admin endpoint. Ensure the request includes necessary fields for a valid user creation and verify the response.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created municipality user via /users/municipality-users/{id} if it was successfully created, or verify no resource exists if creation failed.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates admin capability to create users per PT02.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'technical office staff member') to an existing municipality user. Verify the assignment is recorded correctly.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Remove the assigned role from the user via /users/municipality-users/{id}/roles if necessary.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates admin capability to assign roles per PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Verify the stateful dependency between /email/send-verification and /auth/verify. First, send a verification email (mocked), then immediately attempt to verify with the correct code. Ensure the flow works as expected.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the state dependency where verification code must be sent before it can be verified per dependency_edges.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for report classification.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new report with valid geographic coordinates (lat/lon), a mandatory category from the fixed list, and a detailed description. Ensure the payload includes all required fields for correct classification logic.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of report creation and classification based on provided details.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees list of assigned reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Retrieve the list of reports assigned to a specific technical office staff member using their municipality user ID. Ensure the response includes report summaries and current statuses.
setup_needed: /auth/session (POST) to establish staff session; POST /users/municipality-users to create a test staff user if not present
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the overview functionality for technical office staff.
